description: Three identical repeats of the selected equal-third Throughput-Jain-Service reward under seed 1701. This round changes no reward, PPO, architecture, environment or network model. It measures within-runtime repeatability before Dynamic CQI is introduced.

analysis.title: Round 09 — T–J–S reproducibility diagnostic
analysis.decision_rule: If all three repeats have identical seeded RNG/model initialization and the non-timing training trajectory plus final model parameters are identical, within-session reproducibility passes. Otherwise run a deterministic-lock diagnostic before changing the network model.

cases.label: T–J–S seed 1701 — repeat 01
cases.hypothesis: An identical rerun in the same runtime should reproduce the same initialized model, training trajectory and deterministic validation if the current CPU pipeline is repeatable.
